caption: The drawing depicts a round pocket watch with a gold-colored outer case and a circular loop at the top for attaching a chain. The face of the watch features two inner circles: the larger main dial in the center displays Roman numerals from I to XII and has three thin black hands, two for hours and minutes and a third to indicate seconds. Below the center, there is a smaller sub-dial with Arabic numerals in increments of 10, displaying seconds with a single, thin black hand. Surrounding the main dial, on the white face of the watch, there is a secondary scale marked in increments of 2 up to 60, and a third, outermost scale marked with numbers in increments of 4, up to 60. The text in the middle of the watch face reads: "IMPROVED SPORTING WATCH APPLETON TRACY & CO. WALTHAM. MASS." Below the watch, the words "TWICE ACTUAL SIZE" and "HARRY ABERDEEN" are written in small black letters. The background is plain and off-white in color.
title: Sporting Watch
